summary: Bladex, Inc., a Panama-based foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for Q2 2026. The filing reports balance sheet and income statement data, including total assets of $14.4 billion, net interest income of $143.5 million for the half-year, and equity of $1.76 billion. No transaction, strategic initiative, or special-situation event is described. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a US quarterly report. No unusual items, tender offers, or capital actions are mentioned, and no special-situation classification applies.
